CustomObject.label: OI Hierarchy Relationship
CustomObject.description: One parent-child link between two business records within a Hierarchy Definition (FR-005) — a plain, mutable "current relationship" row, deliberately not ADR-0014's immutable-version-ladder pattern (ADR-0022): every change is a discrete, user-driven move, and native Reports (FR-026) need to query this table directly without an Is_Current__c-style predicate. Lookup, not Master-Detail, to Definition so deactivating a definition never cascade-deletes relationships (FRD Business Rule 7).
